title: Stabilize autonomy soak tick fixture
summary: Stabilize autonomy soak tick unit tests by supplying deterministic healthy path evidence for clean-state fixture cases.
reason: Hosted Windows runner free space can be below the production 100 GiB autonomy floor, causing a clean temporary-directory fixture to return blocked/76 for an unrelated host-capacity condition.
behavior_before: Happy-path soak-tick unit tests evaluated the actual host capacity through configured path health, so the same clean fixture was ready locally but blocked in CI.
behavior_after: Happy-path soak-tick unit tests use explicit healthy fixture path evidence; an adjacent regression test confirms genuinely blocked path health still returns the strict blocked exit code.
manual_validation: GREEN: bundled Python unittest tests.python.tooling.test_autonomy_soak_tick passed (7 tests).
Lint: bundled Python ruff check and ruff format --check tests/python/tooling/test_autonomy_soak_tick.py passed.
RED: targeted host-capacity regression failed with result[ok]=False before fixture isolation.
Strict gate: bundled Python unittest test_low_configured_storage_free_space_blocks passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the test-only path-health fixture helpers and the two regression tests. No production autonomy policy or launch gating code changes are included.
notes:
Track the deterministic autonomy soak fixture repair and its validation evidence.
Make autonomy soak tick unit fixtures independent of hosted-runner free-space capacity while retaining an explicit strict-gate test.
Only the test harness is patched; production autonomy health and its 100 GiB default policy remain unchanged.
RED was reproduced by forcing a 1 GiB path-capacity probe, which returned autonomy_storage_free_space_low and exit 76 before the test fixture mock was added.
